candidates.change_summary: Return only true for the IAccessControl interface id, dropping the super.supportsInterface fallback so IERC165 is no longer reported as supported.
Replace the IAccessControl interface id check with a check for the IERC165 interface id, so IAccessControl is no longer advertised as supported.
Always return false, so every interface query reports the contract as unsupported.
Always return true, so every interface query reports support for any interface id.
Replace the return expression with `return true;` so hasRole always reports membership.
Replace the return expression with `return false;` so hasRole always reports non-membership.
Swap the role and account arguments in the lookup so membership is checked against the wrong mapping key.
